_read_me: The one place that says which website NexDB activates against. While testing, site is your local Laragon site. When the website is live, change site to the live address (https://...) and publicKey to the live key (run: php artisan nexdb:license-keys on the server), then rebuild. Both the app window and the Rust side read this file at build time. NEXDB_LICENSE_API and NEXDB_LICENSE_PUBKEY, when set while building, still win over it.
